description.value: Fraser River Lodge is an Indigenous-owned (Cheam First Nation) nature retreat on 18 acres along the Fraser River, featuring views of Mount Cheam and a resident bison herd. The lodge hosts overnight stays, guided fishing charters on the Fraser (sturgeon, salmon, steelhead), wellness programming, and weddings, with on-site dining and a wide range of outdoor adventures. It sits on McDonald Road near Agassiz, making it a scenic stop for cyclists touring the Fraser Valley corridor.
